summary: Ported the generator's cache-enabled auto-refresh scaffolding (internal/cli/auto_refresh.go, internal/cliutil/freshness.go, and the PersistentPreRunE wiring in root.go) from a scratch cache-enabled regeneration, scoped only to the category resource.
reason: The initial print declared cache.enabled without a working syncable list endpoint for server/skill/mcpclient (those were later rebuilt as hand-written commands, see mcpmarket-jsonld-extraction.json), which caused a data-corruption bug when auto-refresh fired against them. Removing cache entirely regressed the cache_freshness quality dimension. Since category kept its generator-emitted list endpoint (link extraction, no JSON-LD ambiguity), auto-refresh is safe to enable for that resource specifically; the scaffolding was generated once into a scratch directory and copied in rather than risking a full in-place regeneration over the hand-written novel command files.
validated_outcome: doctor reports 'Cache: fresh' after a category browse; 127/127 live dogfood tests passing; scorecard cache_freshness dimension went from 5/10 to 10/10.
